contract.purpose: Document the GitHub-first MAGRA install path and release metadata.
contract.scope: README install section, package repository metadata, badges, package files, and release notes.

interfaces.interface-2: package.json repository, bugs, homepage, files, and version

invariants.invariant-1: The one-command GitHub installer is the first documented install path.
invariants.invariant-2: npm usage remains secondary until an npm MAGRA publish is performed.
invariants.invariant-3: Release docs preserve upstream attribution while naming MAGRA as the product.
